reviews.classification: complete research-retention/dispatch/ending-map owner with source-local proof limits
reviews.disposition: The complete21-line retention index was reviewed. Retained authored tables/dialogue pools, hash captures, literal-reference scans, selected assembly/decompiles, relation cells, helper names and positional save locators have different evidence depths. A next-symbol span is metadata; a RIP-relative reference is not every-path reachability; unaligned exploratory bytes are explicitly excluded. Fourteen-by-fifteen writer cells and input flags are not a live Relations snapshot. Exported full text is not all eligibility predicates or a decoded graph, and writer/integer-reader locator counts do not establish complete string joins or legacy loading. Snapshot addresses and build-scoped IDs require mapping after changes. This guide points to private research, not personal saves. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md) and AD32/AD36 govern a named consumer; no private artifact, native tool, game, database, player state or entitlement was newly inspected. Retained old service/tool statements do not prove a live process.
reviews.evidence: Complete21/24/23/23/23-line input bodies read. Deep report tail and UI/non-UI checkpoint tails are scoped later context; private artifacts and referenced source/runtime evidence were not read by proxy.
reviews.reopen: Use current selected source/material/ending/task and exact original locators; preserve historical ownership, variant costs and unrun proof.

reviews.classification: complete research-retention/dispatch/ending-map owner with source-local proof limits
reviews.disposition: The complete23-line dispatch/completion README was read against the deep report's final checks. Six completed research artifacts and coordinator review do not mean their generators, resolver or native consumers were implemented. Nine exact-fraction example checks establish their arithmetic only; prior44 SOURCE tests, fifteen adversarial vectors, nine physical probes and further ecology/generation cases retain their original unrun/dependency scopes. Material identity/property/process/use must reach an actual selected reader, while available source and retained text are not full reading. Unknown-to-player is distinct from undefined required rule data. Keep quantities, structure, living producers, spiritual identity and retained post-consumption effects under their actual mechanisms, without inventing universal conservation for every magical source. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [making rules](../../../MAKING_RULES.md) and AD51 supersede the retired one-realm/prestige gate and any mandatory Village-first implementation order. Laptop-first means desktop priority with current UI targets, not a fixed historical size. Old sole-writer/subagent records are dated, not a new dispatch. No material/source book, rule executor, source code, game, acquisition or private save was newly inspected or modified.

reviews.classification: complete research-retention/dispatch/ending-map owner with source-local proof limits
reviews.disposition:
All23 lines were reviewed, including each of seven ending joins and both deadline/sponsorship comparisons. Public service alone does not prove a resilient substitute; refusal differs from failing a charter already undertaken; private practice differs from the mature specialist feat; consent, payer, stock and recipient remain actual succession conditions. Composable endings and nine illustrative signatures are not exclusive finalizers or the whole completion denominator. Retained departure is not automatically earned return, a life ending or whole-world delivery.

The arithmetic480+1040=1520 exceeds the proposed1440-minute window before local work; this supports the exact schedule conflict, not a new measured pacing result or a requirement to shrink geography. The2160 fixture and local1440 plan need explicit selection by their actual owner, as do the different four-coin/up-to-eight-minute resident sponsorship versus two-coin/six-minute player-paid fixture. They cannot share invented payment receipts. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../../PROJECT.md), [world-entry rules](../../../../../WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md) and source/world owners govern selected work. Historical33-parent/15-step/seven-ending/twelve-future-journey planning completeness is not behavior proof. No current deadline/actor/item/source rule, runtime, test, native wage or private history was newly inspected or changed.

reviews.classification: complete research-retention/dispatch/ending-map owner with source-local proof limits
reviews.disposition: The complete23-line dispatch record was read with the later UI release and non-UI B385 checkpoint sections. Creation was dispatch, not completed implementation. The later saved checkpoints qualify the initial brief: bounded UI evidence/releases and non-UI documentary corrections have their own inputs, checks and remaining scopes. The two historical chat IDs, configured-default-model wording and writer assignments are not current process/ownership evidence or permission to create chats now. R1 remains a separate preference-sync/publication owner; a repository pointer does not publish vault changes. Keep previous no-dispatch statements as earlier phases rather than treating them as a continuing veto or inventing approval of unseen outgoing text. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../PROJECT.md), [UI rules](../../../../UI_RULES.md), AD32/AD36 and optional human review govern selected changes. No chat was polled, created, messaged or resumed; no runtime, preference source, install, publication, commit or push was performed.
